descFull: Qflow 是一款基于 Python + Tkinter 的轻量级可视化节点办公自动化 (RPA) 引擎。A lightweight, visual node-based RPA engine built with Python & Tkinter. Features flow-chart automation, Smart OpenCV template matching, window binding, and zero-dependency standalone EXE compiler.
